summary: The athlete completed 24 push-up repetitions across three sets (9, 5, and 10 reps), interspersed with downward-dog rest stretches and preceded by prone cobra press-up stretches. Depth and lockout were consistently solid, but form was hindered by excessive hip sag and worming during ascent, alongside cervical hyperextension.
